_A_SKELETON_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The ASkeleton component shows gray placeholders in the shape of the content while it is loading. The page does not jump when the content appears. Screen readers announce the loading text, the shapes are hidden from them.
_A_SKELETON_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Without props the skeleton shows a title and three rows.
_A_SKELETON_ROWS_DESCRIPTION_: avatar adds a circle on the left, title turns the title off and rows sets the number of rows. The last row is shorter, like the end of a paragraph.
_A_SKELETON_ANIMATED_DESCRIPTION_: :animated="false" turns the moving band off. With the system setting “reduce motion” the animation is always off.
_A_SKELETON_LOADING_DESCRIPTION_: While loading is true, the skeleton is shown, then the default slot.
_A_SKELETON_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTION_: The slot template replaces the default layout. Build it from ASkeletonItem in the shape of the real content, e.g. a card.
_A_SKELETON_COUNT_DESCRIPTION_: count repeats the skeleton, e.g. for list items or table rows. The slot template gets the index of the repetition.
_A_SKELETON_VARIANTS_DESCRIPTION_: variant sets the shape. width and height change the size; a number is taken as pixels.
_A_SKELETON_THROTTLE_DESCRIPTION_: With throttle (ms) the skeleton is shown only if the loading takes longer. A fast answer does not make the skeleton flicker.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_ANIMATED_: Shows a moving band over the shapes.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_AVATAR_: Default layout: shows a circle on the left.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_COUNT_: How often the skeleton is repeated.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_EXTRA_: Values for the placeholders of the loading text.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_LOADING_: Shows the skeleton. With false the default slot is shown.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_ROWS_: Default layout: the number of text rows.
_A_SKELETON_PROPS_THROTTLE_: Delay in milliseconds before the skeleton is shown.
_A_SKELETON_ITEM_PROPS_HEIGHT_: Height of the shape. A number is taken as pixels.
_A_SKELETON_ITEM_PROPS_WIDTH_: Width of the shape. A number is taken as pixels.
_A_SKELETON_SLOT_DEFAULT_: The content that is shown when loading is false.
_A_SKELETON_SLOT_TEMPLATE_: Own layout of the skeleton instead of the default one. The slot scope provides index.
